value.sql: SELECT `Month`, `Overturned Cases`, `Closed Cases`, CASE WHEN `Closed Cases` = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * `Overturned Cases` / NULLIF(`Closed Cases`,0), 2) END AS `Overturn Rate` FROM (SELECT date_format(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Overturned Cases`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Closed Cases` FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final` WHERE `Closed Date (CaseHistory)` >= '2025-10-01' AND `Closed Date (CaseHistory)` <= '2026-10-31' GROUP BY `Month` ORDER BY `Month` ASC) AS sub

value.key_finding: Total_Appeals averaged 322.6 per month over 31 periods, with the most recent month at 149, a drop of 53.8% from the average.[F10,F17] This is 174 fewer than in 2024-01.[F4]

business_impact: Planning capacity based on the 31-period average of 322.6 would over-provision resources for the current demand of 149.[F10,F17] The sharp decline may increase SLA exposure if staffing is not adjusted, as fewer appeals could lead to backlog during peak periods.[F9]
